question: What claim about the count and nature of attainment obligates the fair-faced one to recognize eightfold root-kaula siddhi-attainment as the object at stake?
premises: A count of eight is being set forth here.
A connective links that count to a specific attainment.
The attainment named is directed to the fair-faced one as addressee.
inference: Eight items of root-kaula siddhi-attainment are presented together for recognition by the addressed one.
uncertainties: Exact internal scope of the fused compound remains unclear from this token alone.
plain_english: And eight, O fair-faced one, are the siddhi-attainments of the root Kaula.
